episodes.title: The Bad Beginning: Part One
episodes.summary: After they lose their parents and their homes in a fire, the Baudelaire children are placed with their nearest relative, Count Olaf. Unknown to anyone, Olaf plans to obtain the family fortune once Violet comes of age... by hook or by crook.

episodes.title: The Bad Beginning: Part Two
episodes.summary: Olaf schemes to marry Violet and obtain the Baudelaire fortune under the pretense of staging a play.

episodes.title: The Reptile Room: Part One
episodes.summary: Following the sham wedding ceremony, Olaf manages to escape while the Baudelaire siblings are sent to live with their herpetologist uncle Dr. Monty Montgomery, who has come across a reptile known as the "Incredibly Deadly Viper". While attempting to learn more about Monty, a skeptical Klaus discovers that the hedge maze is the same shape as the tattoo on Olaf's ankle. Meanwhile, Olaf poses as Monty's new assistant to get close to the Baudelaire.

episodes.title: The Reptile Room: Part Two
episodes.summary: The Baudelaires find Uncle Monty dead, apparently killed by the Incredibly Deadly Viper. However, once Poe arrives, the children try to expose the real murdrerer.

episodes.title: The Wide Window: Part One
episodes.summary: The orphans move in with their newest guardian, Aunt Josephine. Josephine is paranoid after the death of her husband at the snouts of leeches, and a stickler for grammar. However, neither one protects her from Olaf, disguised as Captain Sham.

episodes.title: The Wide Window: Part Two
episodes.summary: The Baudelaires soon realize that Josephine's suicide note contains a secret message. But to get away from Poe and a disguised Olaf, they must first take advantage of their allergy to peppermints.

episodes.title: The Miserable Mill: Part One
episodes.summary: The children make their way to the Lukcy Smells Lumbermills, and discover that their parents are believed to have burned down the nearby town. The Baudelaires are put to work, and Klaus soon falls under the hypnotic spell of Dr. Orwell.

episodes.title: The Miserable Mill: Part Two
episodes.summary: Violet must find the trigger word to free Klaus from Orwell's hypnotic spell before it's too late for Charles.

episodes.title: The Austere Academy: Part One
episodes.summary: The Baudelaires discover that their new boarding school is unfortunate, and meet a pair of orphans whose life-story is strangely similar to their own. Meanwhile, Olaf prepares to return to his alma mater and bypass the computer scanning system.

episodes.title: The Austere Academy: Part Two
episodes.summary: While the Quagmires keep up the search, the Baudelaires struggle to balance their studies with a punishing workout schedule courtesy of Count Olaf.

episodes.title: The Ersatz Elevator: Part One
episodes.summary: The Squalor take the Baudelaires in because orphans are "in", and the Baudelaires suspect that the Quagmires are hidden somewhere in the Squalors' building. Meanwhile, Jacques recruits Olivia into VFD, and Olaf performs a musical number at Herring Houdini.

episodes.title: The Ersatz Elevator: Part Two
episodes.summary: After the Baudelaires find and lose the Quagmires, and narrowly escape death, they go to the auction house where Olaf and Esma are auctioning off an item containing the captive Quagmires.

episodes.title: The Vile Village: Part One
episodes.summary: The village of VFD offers to become the Baudelaires' guardians, and the Baudelaires accept since they figure the town is tied to the VFD organization. Things look better when Jacques captures Olaf... but soon become grim again.

episodes.title: The Vile Village: Part Two
episodes.summary: Olaf and Esme arrest Baudelaire for killing Jacques, who everyone thinks is Olaf. The orphans must escape before Hector leaves the Vile Village.

episodes.title: The Hostile Hospital: Part One
episodes.summary: Fleeing a murder charge, the Baudelaires end up at Heimlich Hospital and look for the files that will explaining everything that has happened. Olaf and his troupe infiltrate the hospital, and Esme continues her search for the sugar bowl.

episodes.title: The Hostile Hospital: Part Two
episodes.summary: Klaus and Sunny disguise themselves as a doctor to search the hospital for Violet... who Olaf is preparing for the world's firs cranioectoimy.

episodes.title: The Carnivorous Carnival: Part One
episodes.summary: The Baudelaires pose as Siamese twins and a feral baby to infiltrate a carnival where Olaf has come looking for answers from a mysterious fortuneteller, Madame Lulu.

episodes.title: The Carnivorous Carnival: Part Two
episodes.summary: Olaf prepares a new act for the carnival: two carnivorous lions. Now all he has to do is feed one of the freaks to the lions... and the Baudelaires are disguised as conjoined twins.

episodes.title: The Slippery Slope: Part One
episodes.summary: Violet and Klaus rescue themselves from not-so-certain death, and set out to find Sunny. They find Carmelita and a troop of Snow Scouts instead, and one Snow Scout that knows the way to the not-so-secret secret VFD HQ.

episodes.title: The Slippery Slope: Part Two
episodes.summary: Violet and Klaus team up with the third Quagmire, while Sunny acts as a spy in Olaf's camp.

episodes.title: The Grim Grotto: Part One
episodes.summary: Fiona Widdershins of the Queequeg rescues the Baudelaires and then continues on her mission to find the sugar bowl.

episodes.title: The Grim Grotto: Part Two
episodes.summary: Violet and Klaus race to save Sunny from the Medusoid Mycelium, and learn a shocking secret about Hook-Handed Man.

episodes.title: The Penultimate Peril: Part One
episodes.summary: At Kit's request, the Baudelaires infiltrate the Hotel Denouement as concierges and try to work out what's going on at the Last Safe Place.

episodes.title: The Penultimate Peril: Part Two
episodes.summary: Strauss and her two fellow judges hold Olaf for trial in the Hotel Denouement lobby, but things don't go as planned.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.summary: Olaf and the Baudelaires arrive on a deserted island that isn't so deserted, and the orphans learn more about their parents.
